messages.body_plain:
Hi,

ryp2-2.8.3 is out and on pypi. This is a bugfix release in the 2.8.x series.
The list of changes is here:

http://rpy2.readthedocs.io/en/version_2.8.x/changes.html#release-2-8-3


Best,


Laurent
